sections.en:
1 Δωδεκατόρκης ('Dodecatorkes') P. τὸ ('the') omitted by P. 2 ἐν ('in') omitted by M. ιβʹ ('12') P : ιςʹ ('16') M correctly; namely the year
6516. 5 Ἔτος Κριοῦ ('Year of Aries') P (αʹ ['1'] I have added) : omitted by M (second hand adds Κριοῦ ['of Aries']). 6 τραχῦνον ('roughening') corrected by
Usener : ταχινὸν ('swift') P M. 8 ἐνοδηγοῦσθαι ('to be guided in') P M; I have enclosed in brackets. 7 ἐπιτεταγμένος ('enjoined')
P M : corrected by Usener. For midwinter itself falls on the 5th day before the Kalends of February (see above p. 141).
9 Ὀκταβαίου ('of Octavius') I have added; cf. prolegomena. 11 τῇ ('to the') I have added. 12 πνεύματα τὰ πυκνὰ ('the frequent winds') P M.
13 ἔτη ('years') P and M first hand (corrected by second hand). πρὸ εʹ ('before the 5th') : it seems it should be written πρὸ ςʹ ('before the 6th'), see above
p. 143, 2. μαίω ('in May') P : μαίου ('of May') M. 14 Δρουσαίου ('of Drusus') I have added, see prolegomena. καματῶδες ('tiresome')
P M. 17 συντελεῖ ('contributes') P M. ἀγριπαίου ('of Agrippa') P M. εἰ – γίνεται ('if – happens') I have restored from conjecture : εἰ δὲ
μὴ οὕτω γενόμενος κατὰ δὲ ἕτερον γίνεται ('but if not happening thus, it happens according to another') P : εἰ δὲ μὴ οὕτω ἀλλὰ καθέτερον
γένηται ('but if not thus but otherwise it should happen') M. 19 τοῖς ('to the') omitted by P. 20 εὐχώριον ('spacious') seems to be said once (hapax legomenon) : or εὐχάριτον ('graceful')?
In the margin of M first hand : ἔτους ͵ςυνζʹ ('of the year 6457' = 949 A.D.) πρῶτον ἔτος ('first year')· καὶ πάλιν ἐν ('and again in')
τῷ ͵ςθʹ ('the [year] 6009' = 961) ἔτος <αʹ> ἐστίν ('is the <1st> year').

summary.headline: First Dodecaeteris: Year of Aries
summary.text: Discussion of the dodecaeteris calendar and its Augustan origin, followed by the first dodecaeteris: a forecast for year 1 of Aries, describing severe snowy winter, seasonal winds and rains, scorching spring and autumn, abundant rivers, sowing dates, grain, cattle, and general prosperity.
